hints.title: Subarray Traversal
hints.text: Given n <= 100, we can iterate over all subarray start and end indices.

hints.title: Distinct Counting
hints.text: For each fixed starting point, expand the subarray rightward while maintaining a set of seen values.

hints.title: Summing Squares
hints.text: Add the square of the set size to the running total for every step.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Iterating all pairs with running distinct set.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(n^3) naive subarray extraction is unnecessary when set updates incrementally in O(1).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) set storage per starting index.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that O(n^2) easily passes small constraints.
